title: Equipment Sales
shortDesc: Wide range of new and refurbished medical equipment
fullDesc: We offer a rigorous selection of medical equipment from the world's leading manufacturers. Whether for imaging, the operating room, or intensive care, we assist you in choosing the equipment best suited to your practice and budget.

faq.q: Do you offer refurbished equipment?
faq.a: Yes, we offer a certified range of refurbished equipment with a 12-month warranty.

faq.q: What are the delivery lead times?
faq.a: Lead times vary from 24 hours for consumables to 4-6 weeks for heavy equipment made to order.

faq.q: Is your equipment approved for the Algerian market?
faq.a: Yes. Every device ships with CE certification and ISO 13485 marking, and we provide the technical file required by the national pharmaceutical products agency to register medical devices.

faq.q: Do you handle customs clearance and freight?
faq.a: We manage the full import chain: bank domiciliation, clearance at the port of Algiers or Oran, and delivery to your facility. You deal with a single point of contact.

faq.q: What payment terms do you offer?
faq.a: We accept bank transfer, documentary letter of credit and, for public institutions, payment against an administrative purchase order. Instalments are available on heavy equipment.

title: Installation & Training
fullDesc: Purchasing equipment doesn't stop at delivery. Our biomedical engineers ensure turn-key installation, device calibration, and complete training for your teams for an immediate and secure startup.

faq.q: Is training included in the price?
faq.a: Yes, a basic training session is included with any purchase of heavy equipment.

faq.q: Can we train new employees later on?
faq.a: Abolutely, we offer additional training sessions upon quote.

faq.q: Is the training delivered in Arabic?
faq.a: Our trainers work in Arabic, French or English depending on your team’s preference. Written material is handed over in all three languages.

faq.q: How long does commissioning a technical unit take?
faq.a: Allow one to two days for a single device, and three to five days for a complete unit including connection, calibration and measurement validation.

faq.q: Do participants receive a certificate?
faq.a: Each participant receives a personal certificate listing the modules completed — a useful document during inspections and accreditation procedures.

title: Maintenance & After-Sales Service
fullDesc: The availability of your equipment is critical. We offer preventive and corrective maintenance contracts, with guaranteed intervention within 24h/48h and a substantial stock of spare parts.

faq.q: What types of maintenance contracts do you offer?
faq.a: We offer 'Serenity' (all-inclusive) and 'Essential' (labor included, parts extra) contracts.

faq.q: Do you service all brands?
faq.a: We are authorized for major brands and can service most equipment on the market.

faq.q: How fast do you respond to a breakdown?
faq.a: Under a premium contract a technician arrives within 24 hours in Algiers and 48 hours elsewhere in the country. Remote diagnosis starts as soon as you call so the right part is brought along.

faq.q: Do you keep spare parts in stock?
faq.a: Our Algiers warehouse holds wear parts for the ranges we distribute. Device-specific parts are ordered from the manufacturer within seven to ten working days.

faq.q: Do you provide replacement equipment during downtime?
faq.a: Premium contracts include the loan of an equivalent device whenever a repair exceeds 72 hours, so your activity is never interrupted.

title: Supply of Consumables
shortDesc: Regular supply of consumables for hospitals and clinics
fullDesc: Never run out of stock again. We set up automatic restocking and volume discounts for your daily medical consumables (gloves, masks, disinfectants, care supplies).

faq.q: Is there a minimum order?
faq.a: Delivery is free for purchases over €500 excl. tax.

faq.q: Can we get samples?
faq.a: Yes, we provide samples to test quality before committing.

faq.q: Do you offer automatic replenishment?
faq.a: We set a delivery schedule based on your actual consumption, with an alert before you run out. You can adjust quantities at any time.

faq.q: How is the cold chain guaranteed?
faq.a: Temperature-sensitive products travel in refrigerated containers fitted with a data logger; the record is attached to the delivery note and archived for three years.

faq.q: Do you deliver to the southern wilayas?
faq.a: Yes, we cover the whole country including Tamanrasset, Adrar and Illizi. Lead times there are two to four days longer depending on the road link.
